integrity: Complete proof and standalone finite numerical checks; no independent audit or theorem-proving certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Single-product, zero-cost, fixed-period expected-revenue model; continuous prices; strictly positive mixture coefficients and distinct exponential valuation rates.
Geometric-rate construction may involve enormous rate separations and low-share classes; no empirical robustness guarantee against noise or parameter error.
No full independent historical priority review; general exponential-polynomial zero bounds are classical, and some higher-order price-mode results may exist elsewhere.
title: A sharp mode count with almost-equal price peaks in exponential-mixture markets
